understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; a level is won only when all goals are simultaneously occupied, and completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel grid increments. Movement can be blocked by walls or other objects, while adjacent pushable blocks may shift when pushed. The blocked indicator is only a heuristic, so movement must be tested. Multiple selectable pieces can be switched using CLICK with their pixel coordinates; clicking a selectable changes the controlled piece without moving it.
